FileConverter.text: Thermo .raw files were converted to mzML with FileConverter

DecoyDatabase.text: Decoy sequences were added to the protein database with DecoyDatabase
DecoyDatabase.reference: Elias JE, Gygi SP. Target-decoy search strategy for increased confidence in large-scale protein identifications by mass spectrometry. Nat Methods. 2007;4(3):207-214. doi:10.1038/nmeth1019

DecoyDatabase-contaminants.text: Decoy sequences of the contaminant proteins were added with DecoyDatabase
DecoyDatabase-contaminants.reference: Elias JE, Gygi SP. Target-decoy search strategy for increased confidence in large-scale protein identifications by mass spectrometry. Nat Methods. 2007;4(3):207-214. doi:10.1038/nmeth1019

ProSE.text: Spectra were searched against the protein database with ProSE

PercolatorAdapter.text: Peptide-spectrum matches were rescored with Percolator
PercolatorAdapter.reference: Käll L, Canterbury JD, Weston J, Noble WS, MacCoss MJ. Semi-supervised learning for peptide identification from shotgun proteomics datasets. Nat Methods. 2007;4(11):923-925. doi:10.1038/nmeth1113

ProteomicsLFQ.text: Peptides and proteins were quantified label-free with ProteomicsLFQ

IsobaricAnalyzer.text: Reporter ion intensities were extracted with IsobaricAnalyzer

IDMapper.text: Identifications were mapped to the quantified spectra with IDMapper

FileMerger.text: The files were merged with FileMerger

ProteinInference.text: Proteins were inferred from their peptides with ProteinInference

IDConflictResolver.text: Conflicting identifications of a spectrum were resolved with IDConflictResolver

ProteinQuantifier.text: Proteins were quantified from their peptides with ProteinQuantifier
